units.name: 龍騰 B1 L1　Firsts in Life

src.g: B1 L1 文法：名詞子句
src.c: B1 L1 克漏字・文意選填

v: memory (n.) 記性；have a good memory 記性好
reply (n.)[C,U] 回答；make a reply 作出回覆
yell (vi.) 大喊；yell at sb. 對某人吼叫
perfect (adj.) 完美的；practice makes perfect 熟能生巧
accident (n.)[C] 意外；by accident 偶然地
failure (n.)[C,U] 失敗；end in failure 以失敗收場
presentation (n.)[C] 報告；give a presentation 做報告
present (vt.) 提交；present a report 提交報告
present (vt.) 授予；present sb. with sth.
skip (vt.) 故意不參加（該做的事）；略過
ruin (vt./n.) 破壞；fall into ruin 荒廢
reflect (vi.) 認真思考；reflect on 反省
remind (vt.) 提醒；remind sb. of sth.
reflect 認真思考；也可指「映出影像」
The boy's face turned red with ____ when the girl said she did not want to go out with him.
embarrassment 尷尬；turn red with embarrassment 尷尬到臉紅
When I was an elementary school student, my teacher asked me to ____ a new poem every day.
When the reporter asked the singer about her boyfriend, she just ____ that he was like an angel.
The talented Leonardo DiCaprio will be the ____ choice for the lead in the new movie.
the perfect choice 最佳人選
Oscar made an excuse in order to ____ a class he did not like.
Looking at his own ____ in the mirror, Sidney found that some of his hair had turned gray.
Kelly felt very ____ because she didn't do well on the English test.
The fierce civil war eventually led to the ____ of its capital and left numerous people homeless.
Allen felt quite ____ when he mistook a stranger for his girlfriend, Julia.
Diana thinks that she was ____ to get the last ticket to her favorite singer's concert.
be fortunate to V 很幸運能…
Gary finally ____ that health was very important after he came down with a serious illness.
I am sure I must have met that young man before, but I just can't ____ his name.
Looking at these old photos always brings back many pleasant ____ of her childhood.
bring back memories 勾起回憶
One of the most ____ moments in her life is when Vincent suddenly proposed to her.
The end of the year is a perfect time to ____ on achievements and set goals for the future.
Kevin's new restaurant was a total ____. It cost him a fortune and caused him to go broke.
a total failure 徹底失敗
A good speaker knows when to pause during the ____ to catch the attention of the audience.
In Taiwan, it is ____ for people to eat rice dumplings on Dragon Boat Festival.
The Wangs ____ locked themselves out of the house and had to wait for a locksmith.
An earthquake hit the city and caused two old buildings to collapse. ____, no one got seriously injured.
My homeroom teacher was angry at George because he was ____ at others in the middle of the class.
yell at sb. 對某人大吼
After studying hard for a whole year, I finally ____ my dream of entering a medical college.
realize one's dream 實現夢想
My mother often ____ me to follow traffic rules and drive slowly.
remind sb. to V 提醒某人做…
Everyone was having fun at the party, but Frank's rude behavior ____ the atmosphere.
Daryl took a few bites of the cake and then gave ____ of it to his little sister.
Deborah decided to visit the museum ____ instead of looking at the paintings online.
Archie loves making fun of people, so don't ____ his words ____.
Roy promised his daughter that he would attend her school play, and he didn't ____ her ____.
Please ____ that you don't go over the speed limit when you are driving.
Most parents ____ their children's needs ____ and want them to be happy.
Every Halloween, the young cousins ____ as their favorite cartoon characters.
She has a good memory ____ names.
have a good memory for… 對…記性好
He recited the poem ____ memory without looking at the page.
The park was built ____ memory of the late president.
____ reply to your question about my health, I am feeling much better now.
in reply to… 作為對…的回覆
fail to VR 未能做到…；fail in + N/Ving
She calls her parents every day without ____.
g: It is obvious ____ he is not telling the truth.
It is + adj. + that 子句；that 只作連接，不具意義
The fact ____ he cheated on the exam shocked the teacher.
The fact that… 同位語 that 子句，句子完整所以用 that
My main concern is ____ we can finish the project on time.
The teacher insisted that every student ____ the report by Friday.
Humans are different from other animals ____ they can use language.
in that… 在於…（唯一能接在介系詞後的 that 子句）
He promised that he would call me and ____ he would never lie again.
兩個 that 子句並列時，第二個 that 不可省略
The question is ____ we should accept his offer.
當主詞補語只能用 whether，不能用 if
I am not sure ____ or not he has finished the assignment.
緊接 or not 只能用 whether
My parents are worried about ____ I can survive in a foreign country alone.
____ the candidate will win depends on young voters.
名詞子句當主詞（放句首）只能用 whether
Please let me know if you ____ the meeting next Monday.
名詞子句（是否）可以用未來式，不用現在式代替
間接問句要還原成 S + V 語序，不可倒裝
I have no idea ____ with the broken computer.
what to do with… 如何處理…；how 後面不接 do
____ do you think caused the accident?
think/believe/suppose 等「認為型」動詞，疑問詞要移到句首
____ he said at the meeting made everyone angry.
said 後缺受詞，子句不完整，所以用 what
The little girl asked her mother ____.
I'm still wondering ____ so early yesterday.
間接問句還原語序；why 不可接 to V
The teacher asked the students ____ in the exam.
ask sb. not to V 轉述否定祈使句
Tom asked me if I ____ to the concert the night before.
轉述時間往前推一層：過去完成式
My father ____ me that he would be home late.
tell sb. that…；say 後面不直接接人
The guide said that water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius.
不變的真理，轉述時仍用現在式
____ breaks the rule will be punished.
Whoever＝anyone who，帶出名詞子句當主詞
You can invite ____ you like to your birthday party.
whomever 是 like 的受詞，用受格
____ happens, I will always stand by you.
Whatever happens 無論發生什麼（後面另有完整主句）
Please hand this envelope to ____ answers the door.
whoever 是 answers 的主詞，用主格；介系詞的受詞是整個子句
It is obvious ____ technology has changed our lives.
It is obvious that… 顯然…
Whoever 當 says 的主詞
____ he will accept the job offer is still under discussion.
名詞子句當主詞只能用 whether
The rumor ____ the singer would retire turned out to be false.
The rumor that… 同位語 that 子句
____ do you suppose will be elected class leader?
suppose 是「認為型」，疑問詞移到句首
____ the new virus originated remains a mystery to scientists.
Where… 當主詞的名詞子句（起源於何處）
The manager didn't mention ____ he would approve the budget or not.
緊接 or not 用 whether
We differ from animals in ____ we can think and speak.
I have no idea ____ with the leftover food after the party.
what to do with 如何處理
The truth is ____ I forgot to set the alarm clock last night.
The truth is that… 事實是…
____ comes to the charity event will receive a free T-shirt.
who is the man in the black suit
who the man in the black suit is
the man in the black suit is who
The witness stated ____ he had seen the suspect running away.
I am curious about ____ made him change his mind so suddenly.
缺主詞，用 what（＝the thing that）
____ knowledge is power is a well-known proverb.
句子完整（knowledge is power），用 That 當主詞
The problem is not ____ we should do it, but ____ to do it.
whether…（是否）；how to V 名詞片語
I know ____ it is difficult to finish this project in a short time.
I am sure ____ they will come to Jackson's party tonight.
The man will soon realize ____ he cannot buy true love, even if he is rich.
I have learned that working hard is the key to success and ____ living a simple life will help me.
兩個 that 子句並列，第二個 that 不可省
All of us think ____ Miss Chen is really good at telling stories.
The students are excited ____ they will have a two-month summer vacation.
be excited that… 對…感到興奮
The young man was ____ that an old apartment should sell for more than one million dollars.
be surprised that… 人對事感到驚訝
Leona ____ she can see her best friend and ____ they will have dinner together tonight.
第一個 that 可省，第二個並列的 that 不可省
The new skirt looks ____ on you. Everyone must be impressed by your style!
My sister made some cookies, and they ____ very delicious.
taste 是連綴動詞，不用被動也不用進行式
This marketing idea ____ creative. It will surely make money for our company.
What's wrong with you? You look ____.
Having dinner at the Wangs' ____ a good idea. Their dishes taste ____.
Don't feel ____ if you can't solve the math problems quickly.
Although the athlete did not win first place, he did not feel ____.
The coffee smells ____, and interestingly, it tastes ____ dark chocolate.
I noticed Jasmine looking ____ at Sam. She looked very ____ at the party.
第一個 look 是一般動詞用副詞，第二個是連綴動詞用形容詞
The food at that restaurant over there tastes ____.
____ I was walking down the street, I met an old friend of mine.
While + 進行式，表「當…的時候」
Cindy is ____ to start her new job because she will meet new people.
____ to bed early, or you will be late for school tomorrow.
祈使句用原形動詞；祈使句 + or… 否則…
I enjoy ____ new languages and ____ them with native speakers.
Wendy enjoys ____ historical novels in her spare time.
My mother bought ____ daily necessities, such as eggs and salt, on her way home.
necessities 是可數複數，用 a few
When the time came ____ Cindy to ____ a speech in public, she was very nervous.
the time for sb. to V 該某人做…的時候
Shawn always feels ____ when he watches ____ NBA games.
Whenever Uncle Peter pays a visit to us, he always comes ____ gifts for everyone.
Lisa felt ____ after she got a very low score in math.
Amy often shares her personal feelings and thoughts ____ her best friend, Betty.
share sth. with sb. 與某人分享
____ you have any questions, ____ free to ask the clerks in our stores.
If 條件句 + 祈使句 feel free to ask
During Kathy's first trip ____ Japan, she visited many places.
____ the end of the game, Patrick got the most points and became the winner.
at the end of… 在…的最後
Penny can't wait to ____ a date with her boyfriend again.
Sophia took a deep breath before she stepped ____ the stage to sing a pop song.
step onto the stage 走上舞台
David was amazed at Cindy's beauty when he saw her ____ the first time.
for the first time 第一次
You had better take an umbrella with you ____ it looks as if it's going to rain.
since 引導原因子句；due to/because of 後面接名詞
When Beatrice showed up ____ a pretty pink dress, she caught everyone's attention.
When Jerry has free time, he enjoys ____ a walk in a small park.
enjoy + V-ing；take a walk 散步
Most children's books are full ____ colorful pictures to attract children.
Tim feels happy now because he is going to take a trip ____ Korea next week.
take a trip to + 地點
Tracy is good at several subjects, ____ English, Chinese, and math.
Hank doesn't want to read the novel because he thinks it's quite ____.
____ up earlier tomorrow morning, so you won't be late for school again.
Henry looked ____ when Nina was telling him how to solve the math problem.
Do you know what does he want for dinner?
Do you know what he wants for dinner?
Do you know what he does want for dinner?
Do you know does he want what for dinner?
間接問句要還原語序，刪掉 does
If he will come to the party is still uncertain.
Whether he will come to the party is still uncertain.
If he comes to the party is still uncertain.
That he will come to the party is uncertain if.
名詞子句當主詞只能用 whether
I am not sure of that she will keep the secret.
I am sure of that she will keep the secret.
I am sure that she will keep the secret.
I am sure of whether that she keeps the secret.
that 子句前不可有介系詞，要把 of 去掉
The teacher suggested that we hands in the reports on Monday.
The teacher suggested that we hand in the reports on Monday.
The teacher suggested that we hands in on Monday the reports.
The teacher suggested we hands in the reports.
He said me that he had been to Japan twice.
He told me that he had been to Japan twice.
He spoke me that he had been to Japan twice.
He talked me that he had been to Japan twice.
tell sb. that…；say 不直接接人
I have no idea why to give up such a good chance.
I have no idea why I should give up such a good chance.
I have no idea why giving up such a good chance.
I have no idea why to giving up such a chance.
why 之後不可接 to V
c: 【校刊訪談】In each interview, a student ____ a significant first-time event from high school.
【校刊訪談】Instead of being ____ in his school uniform, he wore his pajamas to attend class.
be dressed up in… 穿著…
【校刊訪談】He describes a time when his teacher ____ turned on a filter on her computer.
【校刊訪談】The filter made her ____ someone from outer space.
【校刊訪談】Robbie enjoyed his online courses, but he says he ____ prefers being in the classroom.
【校刊訪談】She remembers the first time she ____ her classmates ____.
【校刊訪談】She couldn't believe ____ her team failed because of her poor performance.
【校刊訪談】____, she felt terrible afterwards and tried to learn from her mistake.
【校刊訪談】____ she had never been abroad before, she was very excited.
【校刊訪談】One of her favorite memories was being ____ traditional Korean clothing.
【線上學習】Here are ____ tips to help you have the best online learning experience.
a few + 可數複數，表「一些」
【線上學習】Find a spot to study where you feel ____.
【線上學習】If there are other people around, then ____ you will want headphones.
【線上學習】You need to finish them one by one. ____, you need to set some limits.
【線上學習】You can let your body relax with some quick exercises ____ you're taking your break.
【線上學習】Online learners sometimes say ____ they miss talking to people.
【線上學習】Don't be ____ about asking your teachers questions.
be embarrassed about… 對…感到尷尬
【線上學習】Just ____ you are clear and polite when talking online.
【線上學習】Misunderstandings can happen more easily online than ____.
【線上學習】To sum up: find the ____ study spot, stick to a routine, and reach out for support.
the perfect spot 最理想的地點
【首爾之旅】I was super excited because I was traveling abroad ____ the first time.
for the first time 第一次
【首爾之旅】At first I could hardly believe ____ I was in the land of my favorite K-pop.
【首爾之旅】I enjoyed ____ my favorite Korean barbecue and kimchi.
【首爾之旅】I even ____ in some cute traditional Korean clothing.
dress up in… 穿上…打扮
【首爾之旅】The trip was so great that I felt a little ____ on my way to the airport.
【首次登台】It's important to ____ that performing before an audience can build confidence.
【首次登台】Here are some strategies to help you feel ____ for your first public show.
feel prepared 覺得準備好了
【首次登台】____ the performance ____: The best preparation is quite simply to practice.
【首次登台】When you are well practiced and have ____ your material, you'll have faith in your ability.
【首次登台】This is true even if the audience down ____ makes you nervous.
【首次登台】Be full ____ positivity: try to avoid saying negative things on stage.
【首次登台】____ you engage in positive actions, you encourage the audience to enjoy more.
【首次登台】Just remember to ____ positivity ____; your audience will feel it, too.
【首次登台】Share personal stories ____ the crowd.
【首次登台】Your audience will find ____ your music has meaning and ____ you have put effort in.
兩個並列的名詞子句，第二個 that 不可省
【烘焙比賽】____ Alice's grandfather had given her his secret recipe, she had high hopes.
【烘焙比賽】She ____ in her baking outfit and set off.
【烘焙比賽】When Alice began baking, she felt ____ and had trouble concentrating.
【烘焙比賽】She realized the cruel truth: She had ____ used salt instead of sugar!
【烘焙比賽】She knew ____ she needed to finish her pie to stand any chance of winning.
【烘焙比賽】She thought about how she had ____ herself ____.
let oneself down 讓自己失望
【烘焙比賽】On her way home, she was very ____.
【烘焙比賽】Her mother asked her why she was so ____.
【烘焙比賽】You still have three stages left, and you may win if you try your best for ____ it.
【烘焙比賽】____ the end of the competition, Alice won third place.
at the end of… 在…的最後
【失敗的報告】I was supposed to be the speaker for my team in a group ____.
【失敗的報告】I realized that I hadn't ____ the work ____, but it was too late.
【失敗的報告】As I came off stage, I was full ____ shame.
【失敗的報告】I had done a terrible job, and I felt ____.
【失敗的報告】Thanks to that experience, I now enjoy ____ a better student.
【線上課初體驗】I realized that I could attend class ____ my pajamas.
【線上課初體驗】However, the online environment led to ____ funny moments.
moments 可數複數，用 a few
【線上課初體驗】Our teacher clicked a button that made her face ____ an animal's!
【線上課初體驗】Even so, I'd say that I still prefer ____ classes.
traditional classes 傳統（實體）課程
【線上課初體驗】There's something special about being in a physical classroom ____.
【走出舒適圈】People who are anxious may feel ____ when they have control over their situation.
【走出舒適圈】Such people avoid unfamiliar situations to ____ they remain in control.
【走出舒適圈】Staying in one's comfort zone can make anxiety worse ____ the individual lacks opportunities.
【走出舒適圈】Facing feared situations can enable someone ____ anxiety to develop courage.
someone with anxiety 有焦慮症的人
【走出舒適圈】Trying new things helps create great or unforgettable ____.
【第一次潛水】Sarah felt ____ her nerves drift away, and a feeling of wonder washed over her.
【第一次潛水】____, suddenly, her mask fogged up.
【第一次潛水】He made a signal to ____ her of the steps required to clear the fog.
remind sb. of sth. 提醒某人…
【第一次潛水】After she cleared her mask, she was able to enjoy ____ the dive.
【第一次潛水】Although she was a bit ____ about panicking, she was glad she learned a lesson.
be embarrassed about… 為…感到尷尬
【初次體驗】When she returned home, she couldn't wait to ____ me all about her holiday.
【初次體驗】She had eaten amazing food and ____ in traditional Korean clothes.
【初次體驗】Experiences like this can give us lasting ____.
【初次體驗】She performed poorly, and ____ the end of the speech, her group received a bad grade.
【初次體驗】My friend knew ____ she needed to work harder next time.
【文意選填：小組報告】Team projects can be a ____ for students if organized well.
【文意選填：小組報告】As I ____ on some of the group projects I have assigned, let me share the positives.
【文意選填：小組報告】____, most students enjoy sharing and discussing ideas with classmates.
【文意選填：小組報告】While it is common to have one leader, ____ the group members also make contributions.
【文意選填：小組報告】Completing a successful group project is truly a ____ experience.
【文意選填：小組報告】Sometimes there will be lazy students who ____ meetings and ignore deadlines.
【文意選填：小組報告】These students need to be constantly ____ to do their part.
be reminded to V 被提醒要做…
【文意選填：小組報告】One lazy student can be dealt with, but too many can ____ a project.
【文意選填：小組報告】Lazy students leave the entire team feeling ____ and cheated.
【文意選填：校刊回顧】You are well-prepared and ____ that your microphone and camera are turned on.
【文意選填：校刊回顧】The teacher has ____ used a filter that makes him look like an alien.
【文意選填：校刊回顧】Another interview ____ you about the importance of preparation.
remind sb. about… 提醒某人…
【文意選填：校刊回顧】Your teacher asked your team to prepare a report, but you ____ several meetings.
【文意選填：校刊回顧】You learn about a student's ____ experiences as she travels overseas.
【文意選填：線上教學】I was forced to present all of my ____ online.
【文意選填：線上教學】I still have a very clear ____ of my first class.
【文意選填：線上教學】I began class with a warm, ____ greeting.
【文意選填：線上教學】Then I waited for my students' ____...and waited...and waited.
【文意選填：線上教學】I quickly began to ____ that no one was listening to me.
【文意選填：線上教學】This made me feel pretty ____, so I decided to change my class plan.
【文意選填：記者回憶】I worked as a ____ for the school newspaper.
【文意選填：記者回憶】I worked hard on my writing skills and never ____ any of my English classes.
【文意選填：記者回憶】To this day, I can still ____ many of the stories I wrote for the paper.
【文意選填：記者回憶】The market was full of fresh fruit as well as ____ Mexican food and clothing.
【文意選填：記者回憶】Vendors ____ to the crowds of customers—mostly in Spanish.
【文意選填：記者回憶】I had been a ____ in the Spanish classroom and couldn't understand much.
【文意選填：記者回憶】This always made me feel a little ____, as my grandparents were born in Mexico.
【文意選填：記者回憶】I didn't let my poor Spanish skills ____ my writing assignment.

src.c: B1 L2 克漏字・文意選填

v: introduce (vt.) 使某人初次體驗／介紹：introduce sb. to sth.
personal (adj.) 個人的；personally (adv.) 針對某人地
inspire (vt.) 激勵／激發靈感；inspiration (n.) 靈感
satisfaction (n.)[U] 滿意；with satisfaction 滿意地
satisfy (vt.) 使滿意；be satisfied with 對…滿意
disappointed (adj.) 感到失望的；be disappointed with sb.
romance (n.)[C] 浪漫愛情故事；romantic (adj.) 浪漫的
relation (n.) 關係；in relation to 關於
connect (vt.) 連接：connect A to/with B
be in a relationship 處於戀愛關係中
focus (n.) 關注的焦點；focus on 專注於
refresh (vt.) 刷新／使某人恢復精神
The reason why Daniel made such a big mistake is that he totally ____ his parents' advice.
Frank likes ____ himself with a cold shower in the morning.
refresh oneself 讓自己恢復精神
William often ____ the screen of his smartphone for fear that he might miss something.
refresh the screen 刷新畫面
Tina soon ____ with Jessica because both of them are very interested in dancing.
connect with sb. 與某人建立良好關係
According to the author, the ____ for his new novel came from a strange dream.
draw / get inspiration from 從…獲得靈感
Taiwan is well-known ____ the world for the beauty of its natural scenery.
throughout the world 遍及全世界
I didn't do well on the exam. Mom asked me to ____ more on my studies.
The history teacher ____ the culture of ancient Egypt to her students.
introduce A to B 把 A 介紹給 B
I particularly enjoy reading ____ novels, such as Me Before You.
In ____ to public pressure, the government announced stricter laws.
Though Simon keeps ____ cheating on the exam, none of his classmates believes him.
deny + V-ing 否認做過某事
Rita sent a number of text ____ to her brother this morning.
Many parents often have a hard time ____ with their teenage children.
have a hard time + V-ing；communicate with sb.
He made a terrible mistake out of ____.
out of ignorance 出於無知
To his great ____, he failed to get into his dream university.
to one's great disappointment 令某人非常失望的是
The article draws our ____ to the importance of being good parents.
draw one's attention to 引起某人注意
The students in the class made no ____ to the teacher's difficult question.
make no response to 對…毫無回應
Each of the hikers brought an umbrella and a raincoat ____ it rained.
in case 以防萬一 —— 阿嬤的雨傘就是這樣來的！
Bill is ____ the list of winners to see if he is one of them.
go through 徹底讀過／逐一檢視
Alice and her friends always ____ in a café after school on Fridays.
hang out 一起出去、廝混
Tracy always ____ her older sister Ivy when she has a problem.
turn to sb. 求助於某人
Please don't ____ this ____, but I don't like your shirt.
take… personally 認為是針對個人
December is not cold in Australia. ____, it's the middle of summer.
in fact 事實上（強調某事為真）
Please bring a snack. ____, you should bring a gift for the birthday boy.
Today we'll discuss food waste, which bears some ____ (relate) to the movie we saw.
bear relation to 與…有關聯（名詞 relation）
Instagram has become a popular means of ____ (communicate) for teenagers.
means of communication 溝通方式
The two friends share a close ____ (connect) and each seems to know what the other is thinking.
Sheila was Elvis's ____ (inspire) for this song.
His grades have slipped a lot recently, which deeply ____ (disappoint) his parents.
which 指前面整件事，視為單數 → disappoints
Since I got a pay raise, I have been living in a ____ (relation) comfortable life.
relatively (adv.) 相對地，修飾形容詞 comfortable
g: ____ his careless attitude that cost him the internship.
分裂句（強調句）：It is / was + 強調部分 + that…
It was not until midnight ____ the search team found the missing hiker.
not until 的強調句一定用 that
It was ____ she lost her wallet that she began to double-check everything.
強調原因：It was because… that…
I take ____ that everyone in the group will do a fair share of the work.
take it for granted that… 虛受詞 it
The typhoon made ____ for the ferry to leave the harbor.
make it + adj. + for sb. + to V（虛受詞）
We all found ____ to work with such a demanding client.
It ____ me that I had forgotten to reply to her email.
It occurs to 人 that… 某人突然想到
It is ____ of you to give up your seat to that elderly woman.
個性形容詞用 of（可還原成 You are thoughtful.）
It is ____ blaming yourself for something beyond your control.
It is no use + V-ing 做…是沒有用的
____ I admire most about her is her ability to stay calm under pressure.
名詞子句當主詞用 What（= the thing that）
It was a broken pipe ____ caused the flooding in the basement.
強調事物可用 that / which
It doesn't matter to me ____ we take the bus or the MRT.
虛主詞 it + whether 子句（是否）
It was ____ we were hiking in the mountains ____ the storm hit.
強調副詞子句：It was while… that…
It is generous ____ your neighbor to lend you his car for the whole weekend.
generous 屬個性形容詞 → of
It is not convenient ____ this weekend.
convenient 不可用人當主詞，用 for
It's pointless ____ with someone who refuses to listen.
虛主詞 it，真主詞為不定詞 to argue
The judges considered ____ to disqualify the whole team.
It is no use ____ about the weather; we had better change our plan.
It was never made clear ____ the missing files had gone.
語意是「去了哪裡」→ where 引導名詞子句
It is advisable ____ before the online course starts.
It is + adj. + for 人 + to V
Everyone thought ____ that the star player was benched in the final.
think it + adj. + that 子句（虛受詞）
The coach ____ that latecomers would not be allowed to play.
make it clear that… 虛受詞 it
____ takes about twenty minutes to walk from the dorm to the library.
It takes + 時間 + to V
There ____ neither a fire extinguisher nor smoke alarms on this floor.
neither A nor B 依就近原則，靠近 a fire extinguisher（單數）
____ a problem with the air conditioner in Room 302.
There seems to be…（✗ There seems to have）
There ____ little snow in the mountains so far this winter.
so far 用現在完成式；little snow 不可數 → has been
There was a strange noise ____ from under the hood.
主動、進行 → 現在分詞 coming 修飾 noise
The professor doesn't want ____ any misunderstanding about the grading policy.
want / expect / would like + there to be
There is no ____ what the committee will decide tomorrow.
There is no + V-ing = 無法…
____ no doubt that the new bridge has shortened the commute.
There is no doubt that…（✗ It is no doubt that…）
Once there ____ a small bookstore at the corner of this street.
there + 表存在的不及物動詞（stand / live / remain…）
There are still two reports ____ before Friday.
尚未做、應該做 → 不定詞 to finish
We were annoyed at ____ no explanation for the two-hour delay.
介系詞後用動名詞的 there being
There ____ to be a public swimming pool behind the school.
There used to be… 以前有…
There ____ a serious accident at that intersection last night.
happen 為不及物動詞，不可用被動
There is no point ____ over a decision that has already been made.
There ____ either a mistake in the data or two missing pages.
either A or B 就近原則，靠近 a mistake（單數）
The door swung open, and there ____ .
there + V + S 的倒裝句
I don't want ____ any confusion about the deadline.
There ____ little we can do until the technician arrives.
little 為不可數 → 動詞用單數 is
____ , the concert was canceled at the last minute.
As there was a power failure
兩個子句需連接詞，用 As 引導原因子句
____ to leave the front door unlocked all night.
careless 屬個性形容詞 → of him
____ that the old temple was built more than two centuries ago.
It is said that… 據說…
My grandmother ____ to take a short walk after every meal.
make it a rule to V 習慣於…
It is a bad habit ____ him to check his phone every five minutes.
a bad habit 非個性形容詞 → for
The new software ____ to process thousands of records in seconds.
Advances in medicine have made possible ____ .
the treatment of many rare diseases
受詞太長可後移；名詞片語不加 it
It was on a rainy afternoon ____ the two of them first met.
強調介系詞片語只能用 that
The curtains parted and there ____ under the spotlight.
There ____ no vacancies in the hotel, we had to sleep in the car.
There being + N 分詞構句（因為…）
There are several passengers ____ for the delayed train on the platform.
主動、進行 → waiting 修飾 passengers
It is difficult for me ____ 100 math problems in one hour.
It is + adj. + for sb. + to V
It is ____ to put personal information on social networking websites.
be 動詞後接形容詞 dangerous
It is necessary ____ your seat belt while driving.
真主詞用不定詞 to fasten
It is unwise ____ people to spend so much time on online games.
依課本句型 It is + adj. + for 人 + to V
It is impossible ____ the little boy to lift such a heavy metal box.
impossible 不可用人當主詞 → for
____ is never easy to break an old habit.
虛主詞 It + 真主詞 to V
There is no ____ how the negotiation will end.
There is no telling = 無法預料
c: Sally decided she needed a big change. It ____ her heart, but she knew she had to get rid of her smartphone.
break one's heart 使某人心碎
Her smartphone ____ answers to all kinds of questions.
There were many bad things about always having her smartphone ____ her side.
by one's side 在某人身邊
She was often so busy ____ her phone that she ignored the people around her.
Now she wanted to ____ more time ____ the people she loved.
spend time with sb. 和某人共度時光
Many people enjoy video games. For most, ____ games is a relaxing and harmless pastime.
If you think ____ you or someone you care about has a video game addiction, here are some signs.
think 後接 that 引導的名詞子句
This may cause them to stay up late ____ the night playing games.
stay up late into the night 熬夜到深夜
Addicted gamers may have problems at school because they're so busy ____ games.
They might have difficulty concentrating, and their grades are likely to ____ worse.
get + 形容詞比較級 變得…
Another way ____ addiction is to look for problems with the player's moods and health.
a way to V 做…的方法
They might lose their appetite or spend less time ____ with friends and family.
If someone is addicted, it can be very hard for him to stop ____ video games.
If someone is ____ addicted to video games, he should see a mental health counselor.
Such a professional can help people ____ their behavior and restore a balance in life.
Being with you has ____ me to communicate and connect with others.
inspire sb. to V 激勵某人去…
Whenever you are not ____ my side, I'm constantly checking my messages.
by my side 在我身邊
This is making it difficult to focus ____ my schoolwork!
My parents are so ____ with me.
be disappointed with sb. 對某人失望
Although this all sounds ____ , it is hurting my relationships with my friends and family.
感官動詞 sound + 形容詞
In the beginning, I wanted my first boyfriend to pay ____ to me all the time.
____ to making calls, people also use smartphones for almost everything else!
in addition to + N / V-ing 除了…之外
With my smartphone, I ____ myself to new clients on Facebook.
introduce oneself to sb. 自我介紹
____ the past ten years, I've used my smartphone for many other things.
throughout + 時間 自始至終、整段期間
I did not pay attention in school. I also had little ____ with my family.
have little connection with 與…幾乎沒有交流
Our relationship has been mostly ____ , but I'm afraid it's over.
satisfying (adj.) 令人滿意的，修飾事物
You ____ me to connect with others and to communicate better.
課文原句：You inspire me to connect with others.
I check my LINE app again and again ____ the day.
When it doesn't show any new messages, I still refresh the screen, just ____ I miss something.
When my friends and I hang out, I ____ you for Instagram updates and ignore everyone else.
I can't ____ that you are always by my side.
can't deny that… 不可否認…
When I wake up, you are there to ____ my friends' updates on Facebook with me.

guide (n.)[C] 嚮導；a tour guide 導遊

memorize (vt.) 熟記；memorize words 背單字
memorial (n.)[C] 紀念碑；set up a memorial to sb
project (n.)[C] 專題研究；a project on sth
「（為達成某目的而進行的）活動」的英文是？

These students are on a ____ to raise money for children in need.
be on a mission to do sth 以做某事為使命
The lake is deep in the mountains, and visitors may get lost if they go there without a ____.
Please follow the steps, and they will ____ you through the task.
guide sb through sth 引導某人完成某事
Denny is poor at math, and he often ____ with the exercises in his math workbook.
Students with learning ____ often need help from their teachers and parents.
When Joy studied in New York, she faced many ____.
face a challenge 面臨挑戰
It isn't easy for teachers to ____ every student's name in a short time.
Rebecca has a terrible ____ for dates, so she often forgets her friends' birthdays.
a memory for sth 對某事的記憶力
For her ____ on a famous king in history, Ann decided to write about Louis XIV.
a project on sth 關於某事的專題研究
Biking, camping, and mountain climbing are all common outdoor ____.
Victoria has joined many school clubs and made lots of friends. Clearly, she leads an ____ school life.
an active school life 活躍的校園生活
Developing good ____ skills will help you make new friends more easily.
In a healthy ____, everyone should be taken good care of and treated fairly.
There were so many phone calls this morning that I couldn't ____ on my work.
focus on sth 專注於某事
Erica wore a shiny dress to the party, and she quickly became the ____ of attention.
the focus of attention 注意的焦點
All the workers got a nice trip to Japan as a ____ for their hard work.
a reward for sth 某事的回報
After the boy found Ms. Davis's missing purse, she ____ him with NT$1,000.
reward sb with sth 以某物酬謝某人
Spring, summer, fall, and winter make a full ____ of four seasons each year.
a full cycle 完整週期
I always do a quick ____ and go over all the key points in my notes before exams.
do a review 進行複習
The manager needs to ____ the report one more time before she sends it to the head office.
____ exercise is good for your health, so doctors suggest working out three times a week.
The high speed rail ____ people to travel from Taichung to Taipei in about an hour.
enable sb to do sth 使某人能夠做某事
To make sure he has enough time to finish everything, Mr. Morris ____ his schedule carefully.
The United Nations is one of the most important international ____ in the world.
It will be impossible to carry out the new ____ if we don't have enough money.
carry out a task 執行任務
Don't ____ breakfast just because you are in a hurry.
Let's talk about the big idea first and save the small ____ for later.
Many people ____ a love of reading when they find the right book.
The ____ of oil under the ground has helped the country become one of the richest in the world.
the discovery of sth 某物的發現
The wizard prepared a magic ____ using herbs and magical powders.
The leader of the club welcomed every ____ and patiently explained the rules.
The busy editor ____ the article quickly before the afternoon meeting.
The student ____ the page quickly to find the important date.
You need to ____ your ID card to enter the laboratory.
The teacher asked students to read the ____ carefully before discussion.
The old man climbed the stairs with ____ because of his bad knees.
with difficulty 困難地（介系詞後接名詞）
Many beginners have ____ understanding fast English conversations.
have difficulty (in) doing sth 做某事有困難
This is a ____ problem to solve, so we need more time.
The young writer ____ to finish his first novel before the deadline.
struggle to do sth 艱難地做某事（過去式）
Life in big cities is often a daily ____ for many workers.
a daily struggle 日常奮鬥
The young athlete decided to take ____ a new training challenge.
take on a challenge 接受挑戰
The father asked his daughter to memorize the poem by ____.
memorize sth by heart 把某事背熟
Practice and repetition are important for building long-____ memory.
The students are working ____ a school project on climate change.
work on a project 進行專題
It is important for elderly people to stay ____ and exercise every day.
stay + adj.：stay active 保持活躍
David has many friends and has a busy social ____.
The camera lens is not properly adjusted, so the image is not ____ focus.
in focus / out of focus 有對焦／失焦
The police offered a ____ for those who can provide helpful information.
offer a reward 提供獎賞
In biology class, students studied the life ____ of frogs.
The project is currently ____ review by experts.
My neighbor is a ____ customer at this small coffee shop.
Several students had to skip the morning ____ to prepare for the game.
Our history teacher explained the important event in great ____.
in (great) detail 詳細地（固定用單數）
The young researcher discovered a new chemical by ____.
After years of hard work, the medical team made an important ____ about heart disease.
make a discovery 做出發現
Tim has a lot on his ____ now, and he won't have time to talk about his ideas with us.
have a lot on one's plate 有很多事情要做
In order to strike a ____ between his work and family life, Ted spends weekends with his children.
strike a balance between A and B 在 A 和 B 之間取得平衡
My friend would like some iced lemon tea. As ____ me, a glass of water will be fine.
Nick has to deal ____ this problem as soon as possible, or it will get even worse.
deal with sth 處理某事
Cathy takes a bus ____ driving her car to work because it's hard to find a parking space.
Taking care of two babies at the same time really burns Martha ____.
burn sb out 使某人累垮
We've decided to stick ____ our plan, and we will not make any further changes.
stick to sth 堅持某事
a lot on one's plate 的意思是？
a lot on one's plate 有很多事情要做
strike a balance 的意思是？
strike a balance (between A and B) 取得平衡
stick to sth 維持某事，堅持某事
deal with sth 處理某事物
g: Welcome ____ our beautiful guesthouse in Hualien.
welcome to + 地方 歡迎來到某地
The hotel staff welcomed the guests ____ offering helpful local travel tips.
welcome sb by + V-ing 用…歡迎某人（with 後面接名詞）
Ryan improved his English ____ reading news articles for fifteen minutes every night.
Sarah took a coding class last summer to develop new computer ____.
A police officer came to the tourist's ____ when he lost his way in the city.
come to one's help 協助某人（help 為名詞）
The new computer program helped Emily ____ her financial report much faster.
Nancy helped the senior worker ____ the heavy boxes upstairs.
Let's ____ a walk around the neighborhood to relax after dinner.
Timmy's boss made him ____ overtime to finish the important project.
make sb + 原V 強迫某人做某事
Claire got her brother ____ a new dish by telling him it tasted good.
get sb + to V 使某人做某事（get 是半使役）
Mike had the repair worker ____ the air conditioner.
have sb + 原V 叫某人做某事
Jane loves taking photos of all kinds of interesting street ____.
all kinds of + 複數可數名詞
My mother cleaned the kitchen tools, ____ knives, cutting boards, and pans.
N, such as… ；such as 不放句首，後接名詞
Kelly loves trying new foods. ____, she ordered three dishes she had never tried before.
For example 後面接完整句子，可放句首
Luke tries ____ up earlier, so he can have extra time to prepare breakfast.
try to V 努力做某事
The uncertain weather ____ Sam because he has planned an outdoor event.
worry 當情緒動詞「使…擔心」，主詞單數用 worries
Megan was ____ about her grandmother's health after hearing the news.
sb be worried about sth（修飾人用 -ed）
The drop in temperature was ____ to elderly people in the neighborhood.
sth be worrying to sb（修飾事物用 -ing）
Leon thinks everyone learns differently; ____ his case, he understands better when someone explains.
in one's case 就某人的情況來說
I have trouble ____ the instructions. Can you explain them to me?
have trouble + V-ing 做某事有困難
As the weather turned colder, Adele got ____ that she might catch a cold.
get + adj. 變得…（get 為連綴動詞）
The milk turned ____ because nobody put it back into the fridge.
turn sour 變質（連綴動詞＋形容詞）
Alan already felt sick that morning. What's ____, he also had an important meeting.
what's worse 更糟的是 ＝ worse still ＝ worse yet
Reading long passages usually ____ her feel lost.
動名詞片語當主詞視為單數；make sb + 原V
When Charles couldn't decide between several job options, he felt ____.
feel lost 覺得迷失（feel + adj.）
____ improve his English listening skills, Jason listens to podcasts on his way to school.
To + V 為了…＝ in order to V
Eason picked a new phone case ____ Sally because she couldn't decide.
pick sth for sb 替某人挑選某物
The company gives free lunch ____ its employees every Friday.
give sth to sb；give 是授與動詞
My uncle sent ____ for my birthday.
a gift card for me to
授與動詞 + 人 + 物（不需介系詞）

allow sb to V 允許某人做某事
Lucas reminded his daughter to take a ____ because she had stared at the screen for over an hour.
take a break 休息一下
Kevin took a ____ on the train because he barely slept the night before.
____ dinner, Abigail made herself a cup of tea.
after 當介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞
To stay focused ____ the online meeting, Brad turned off all notifications.
stay focused on + N 保持專注於某事
Regina guided the lost tourist ____ the train station within ten minutes.
guide sb to somewhere 指引某人到某地
The boy smelled ____ coming from the kitchen.
形容詞放在 something 後面：something + adj.
Did you see ____ on your way home?
Hannah brought a book, so she would have something ____ while waiting.
something + to V（修飾不定代名詞用不定詞）
First, my roommate cleaned the table; ____, she arranged the flowers; finally, she lit a candle.
First… then… finally… 表時間順序
George didn't remember ____ the door, so he went back to check it.
remember + V-ing 記得（曾經）做過
Please do not forget ____ off the lights before leaving the office.
forget + to V 忘記去做（還沒做）
You should stop ____ junk food if you want to stay healthy.
stop + V-ing 停止正在做的事
While driving, Nancy stopped ____ an important phone call from her boss.
stop + to V 停下來去做另一件事
Students will not forget the things they have learned ____ they follow the plan.
as long as 只要（條件）
Tom brushed ____ his English before the interview.
brush up on + N 重新複習，恢復熟練度
"Must tasks" are the most important and are ____ first.
When TWICE announced their tour, all the tickets were ____ out in ten minutes.
be sold out 被賣光（被動）
If you want to hold a party, you must plan ____ the number of guests.
plan for + N 為…做規劃
If Jason saves a small amount of money every week, he ____ enough for his trip next year.
if 條件句：if + 現在式, S + will V
John works a part-time job to earn some ____ money.
____ this app, you can learn English anywhere, even on the bus.
with 當介系詞「使用，藉由」

During the summer vacation, Brian made good ____ of his time by learning how to cook.
make good use of one's time 善用時間
Before tidying up the house, my mother broke the work ____ several groups.
break sth into sth 把…分成…
Leo scanned the notice ____ his name.
scan for sth 快速掃視以尋找某物
During the bike trip, Martin took photos of rice fields he discovered ____ the way.
along the way 在途中，沿途

我們是被接，用 to be picked up
By the time the guests arrive, the chef hopes ____ all the desserts.
完成式不定詞 to have p.p. 表比主要動詞更早完成
Ted crashed the school van, but he wasn't fired. He is lucky ____ a second chance.
他是「被」給機會，且早於 is lucky，用 to have been p.p.
The freshmen hope ____ in the school's volunteer program.
hope + to V；新生是被納入，用被動
Ian got into trouble when he refused ____ his backpack for the security guard.
Please forgive me. I didn't mean ____ your feelings.
mean to V 有意要…（mean V-ing 是「意味著」）
This temple is believed ____ during the Qing Dynasty.
廟是過去「被」蓋的：to have been p.p.
Andy seems ____ the novel before. He can even name every character.
before 表更早發生，用 to have p.p.
I'm terribly sorry. I don't mean ____ you, but the principal is waiting outside.
I intended ____ you last night, but my phone ran out of battery.
intended to have p.p. 表「原本打算…卻沒做成」
Although the town is quiet now, it is said to ____ a busy mining center a hundred years ago.
to have been：過去的狀態，早於 is said
The little boy pretended ____ asleep so that his mother would not scold him.
The document is reported ____ by the fire last week; nothing is left.
上週被燒毀，早於 is reported，用 to have been p.p.
I had my brother ____ me to the station.
使役動詞 have + O + 原V
All the audience could do was ____ in silence.
All S have to do is (to) Vr，to 可省略
We were made ____ the classroom after the party.
make 用於被動時要把 to 加回來
Don't make your parents ____ about you.
Several hikers claimed that they had seen a black bear ____ across the trail.
感官動詞 see + O + 原V（表全程、事實）
I finally got my little cousin ____ his toys.
get 是半使役動詞，要用 get + O + to V
Judy went to the salon to have her hair ____ before the ceremony.
have + 物 + p.p. 請人把某物…
The customers can have their groceries ____ to their homes within an hour.
The manager was seen ____ the office right before the money went missing.
感官動詞被動時要把 to 加回來
My parents would let me ____ the concert if I finished all my homework.
Kelly went to the dentist last night to have her wisdom tooth ____.
The whole team was made ____ the gym as a punishment for being late.
I remember this melody. I heard it ____ at the opening ceremony years ago.
it（旋律）是被演奏，用 hear + O + p.p.
Through clever advertising, consumers often ____ themselves be talked into buying useless products.
let + O + be p.p. 是使役動詞唯一的被動形
People with a severe accent sometimes find it hard to make themselves ____.
make oneself understood 讓別人聽懂自己
Scientists still cannot fully explain what makes the ground ____ before a major quake.
Our homeroom teacher always has us ____ the vocabulary aloud twice.
Before the competition, the members were made ____ every single day.
____, the documentary is not as boring as the critics claimed.
to do it justice 公平地說
____ my disappointment, I didn't make it into the final round.
To one's + N 令某人感到…的是
Much ____ her relief, no one mentioned the mistake she made on stage.
Much to one's relief 令某人大大鬆一口氣的是
After the earthquake, ____, the rescue team found all the miners alive.
加強語氣是 Much to one's + N
You ____ out so late; the storm is getting worse.
Nathan would rather ____ the whole night than hand in a careless report.
Watching the puppy chase its own tail, we could not help ____.
cannot help but + 原V＝cannot help + V-ing
She prefers ____ at home to ____ at a noisy café.
The startup launched a free trial ____ more young users to the platform.
The exchange students are eager to know ____.
where can they buy cheap textbooks
how to open a bank account
Sophie stayed up until three, ____ to realize the deadline had been postponed.
Every member trains twice a day with a view ____ the national championship.
with a view to + V-ing 以…為目標（to 是介系詞）
Nick seems ____ this route before. He knows every shortcut.
before 表更早，用 to have p.p.
It is hard to get rid of the habit once you ____ leaving things until the last minute.
be used to + V-ing 習慣於
We are all looking forward ____ the new gym next semester.
The hostel was full, so the backpackers couldn't find a room ____.
a room to stay in，介系詞 in 不可少
We save part of our salary every month in order ____ in trouble someday.
____ Michelle is very proud of her daughter's achievement.
As a care center staff member, Mike considers ____ an honor ____ the residents.
consider it + N/adj. + to V（it 為虛受詞）
Henry dared not look me in the eye; it ____ that he was hiding something from me.
Many Chinese students feel ____ difficult to learn to speak English.
feel it + adj. + to V，it 是虛受詞
It seems that + S + V＝Mary seems to be…
In American offices, most staff find ____ normal to address their bosses by their first names.
We considered it an honor ____ able to do something nice for the teacher.
I highly recommend this novel; you will ____ it inspiring to read.
The students found ____ finish a sixty-page report in a week.
Most people consider ____ necessary to learn English, but Mary thinks otherwise.
We could not wait for more help but found ____ essential ____ immediate action.
find it essential to take action
The teacher frowned when I spoke. It seemed ____ he was not satisfied with my answer.
The moment the hikers saw the elderly man ____ in the animal trap, they ran over.
老人是「被」困住，用 see + O + p.p.
You can hear many people ____ when they are on a roller coaster ride.
感官動詞 + O + V-ing 表正在進行
The manager got fired because he ____ revealing the company's confidential information.
be caught + V-ing 被抓到正在…
To Albert's surprise, he saw a cat ____ in front of his door when he got off work.
Jack is an only child; therefore, he is longing for someone ____.
someone to play with，介系詞 with 不可少
Miss Lin flew into a rage as she found several students ____ to her about their homework.
find + O + V-ing；lie (說謊) 的 V-ing 是 lying
The man was arrested after he was caught ____ beers and snacks from the supermarket.
Henry doesn't feel like apologizing to her ____.
Dinosaurs are extinct. They ____ exist on earth.
no longer 不再（放在一般動詞前）
After ____ from college two years ago, Samuel still doesn't have a stable job.
Let me know ____ you're going to Peter's birthday party next Friday.
if 引導名詞子句，表「是否」
Although Janet is new in our class, she has made ____ friends.
a few + 可數名詞，表「有一些」（肯定語氣）
It is ____ the law to bring produce with you when you enter our country.
____ a career woman, Tina tries hard to strike a balance between family and work.
c: 【Ronald Day】On Ronald Day, I dressed up ____ Ronald McDonald and visited sick children.
【Ronald Day】Most of the children were ____ terminal illnesses.
【Ronald Day】I loved being able to ____ to them.
bring some laughter to sb. 帶給某人歡笑
【Ronald Day】This was because I might ____ them with my painted face and red wig.
【Ronald Day】I wasn't allowed to engage in any physical contact with the children, ____.
【Ronald Day】____ might pass on germs to them.
Doing so 動名詞片語當主詞
【Ronald Day】The voice called, ____ me to push open the door.
分詞構句，主動用 V-ing；prompt sb. to V
【Ronald Day】I found a small boy ____ about five lying in bed.
a boy of about five＝一個大約五歲的男孩
【Ronald Day】The boy asked for a hug. I felt ____. I held him in my arms.
have no choice 別無選擇
【Ronald Day】She wanted to thank me for ____ a difference in his life.
for 是介系詞，後接 V-ing
【Billy】I didn't want to ____ Billy, of course, but I also didn't want to lose my job.
【Billy】We finished our picture, and as I was about ____, Billy asked me again to hold him.
be about to V 正要…
【Billy】At that moment, ____ nothing was as important as the happiness of this sick boy.
【Billy】____ this, I decided to hold Billy despite the risk.
【Whale】____ on its yearly winter journey south, it had become caught in the ropes.
分詞構句：主動且主詞相同，用 V-ing
【Whale】Rescuers checked ____ they could unwind the ropes but found they were too tight.
【Whale】Therefore, they decided to cut the ropes ____.
【Whale】The whale would surely ____ it terrifying to be trapped.
【Whale】One swing of its ____ tail could kill a diver.
【Whale】However, the divers' ____ did not stop them from helping.
【Whale】The first diver wondered whether their help could ____.
make a difference 有所影響
【Whale】About twelve ropes were cutting into the skin, and it ____ that the animal might never escape.
【Whale】It seems they still have a way to ____ their thanks to people who helped them.
【文意選填：工作的意義】They spend the money on themselves and never do anything kind ____ other people.
do something kind for sb. 為某人做好事
【文意選填：工作的意義】Some owners of large ____ do more than just make money.
corporations 大企業（owners of large corporations）
【文意選填：工作的意義】These ____ wish to have a positive effect on society.
employers 雇主，指前文的企業老闆
【文意選填：工作的意義】They want to be ____ assistance to people in need.
be of assistance＝be helpful 提供協助
【文意選填：工作的意義】____, they might set up an organization to help educate children.
【文意選填：工作的意義】____, they would also like to inspire their employees to feel the spirit of sharing.
At the same time 同時
【文意選填：工作的意義】Not all acts of generosity are ____ to the rich.
【文意選填：工作的意義】Rich people sometimes feel it is their duty to ____ in society.
make a difference 帶來改變
【文意選填：工作的意義】____, some of the richest people have been great role models.
【文意選填：生病的孩子】However, when they are ____, all that strict parenting takes a back seat.
【文意選填：生病的孩子】Here are three rules that can be broken when your kids are ____ to their beds.
be confined to bed 臥床
【文意選填：生病的孩子】When children are sick, they tend to ____ certain foods.
【文意選填：生病的孩子】The reason is simple — it ____ them up.
cheer sb. up 使某人開心
【文意選填：生病的孩子】When they are ____ an illness, this impatience can intensify.
suffer from an illness 受疾病之苦
【文意選填：生病的孩子】Usually, I try to ____ good manners to my children.
【文意選填：生病的孩子】When they are under attack by ____, I limit my demands.
【文意選填：生病的孩子】This exception ____ when they are recovering.
make a difference 有所不同、有幫助
【文意選填：Sam 的故事】You might think a person should never ____ the rules.
go against the rules 違反規定
【文意選填：Sam 的故事】Sam was ____ by McDonald's a few years ago.
【文意選填：Sam 的故事】Sam loved to bring ____ to the sick kids.
【文意選填：Sam 的故事】Billy ____ from a very serious disease.
【文意選填：Sam 的故事】____, there was a rule that Sam could not touch the patients.

units.name: 龍騰 B3 L2　The Marshmallow Challenge

src.g: B3 L2 文法：形容詞子句
src.c: B3 L2 克漏字・文意選填

v: promise (n./vt.) 承諾；keep one's promise 守信
promise (vt.) 預示；The dark clouds promised rain.
mention (vt.) 提到；make no mention of 隻字未提
graduation (n.)[U] 畢業；upon graduation 一畢業
construction (n.) 建築物；[U] 建造；under construction 施工中
rank (vi./vt.) 排序為…；rank in the top 1%
adjust (vt.) 調整；adjust A to B
rely (vi.) 依賴；rely on/upon 依賴
element (n.)[C] 要素；a key element 關鍵要素
We need a leader ____ of guiding us through this financial crisis.
be capable of + Ving 有能力做…
In an age that emphasizes ____, young people are encouraged to create something new.
The top priority in its post-war period is to maintain political ____ so as to promote growth.
Andy had assured his boss that the job was well within his ____, but he ruined the project.
within one's capabilities 在能力範圍內
The ____ marketing strategy has successfully boosted sales of the new product.
Tai Tzu-ying is known for being number one in the world badminton ____ for 220 weeks.
The shop features everyday products made of recycled ____.
The world-renowned writer ____ the miserable days of her youth to encourage people.
It is important to always keep your ____, or people won't trust you again.
Every summer our company recruits many college ____.
The ____ of new sources of energy is vital for the future of our planet.
Mr. Smith is a ____ person. He never breaks his promises; you can count on him.
By ____ with local broadcasters, Netflix has continued to lead the streaming market.
Instead of seeing complaints as negative ____, our company views them as opportunities.
The news that a new sports center will be ____ within two years excited the neighborhood.
People usually ____ on the Google Maps app when traveling to new places.
There is a ____ difference between the two designs, but no one seems to notice it.
a slight difference 細微的差異
In his autobiography he made no ____ of his mother.
make no mention of… 完全沒提到…
Our new office building is a steel and concrete ____ that can resist strong winds.
I design activities in which students' ____ will enable them to complete tasks.
Whatever frustrations you might confront, remember that you are ____ and irreplaceable.
The ice palace is an amazing work of ____.
In our ____ English conversation course, students introduce themselves with simple sentences.
The new restaurant's delicious food and excellent service ____ a great experience.
Henry's old house happened to be on the scheduled ____ of the MRT.
Staying positive and eating well are the four key ____ of staying healthy.
The research team wasn't sure which design to use, so they relied on ____.
trial and error 反覆試驗
Helen's ____ because she has the most experience and is likely to lead the team well.
Rather than copy other people, why not ____ a unique exercise plan that works for you?
We've had enough positive feedback. Now it's time to ____ and get to work!
roll up one's sleeves 挽起袖子（開始行動）
The boss wants that report by Monday, so you'd better stop wasting time and ____ it.
get down to... 開始（認真）做某事
Once the teacher explained the rules, the students ____ and quickly started the activity.
get stuck in 投入；開始做
After taking lessons for a year, Martha was capable ____ playing several songs.
The bridge is strong, so it should remain ____ during an earthquake.
Some web pages are still under ____.
Modern ____ tries to conquer nature instead of working with it.
g: The house ____ roof is red belongs to my uncle.
所有格關代用 whose，後面直接接名詞
Mark Twain, ____ real name is Samuel Clemens, was praised as the father of American literature.
whose + 名詞；who's 是 who is 的縮寫
He is one of the boys who ____ chosen for the school team.
先行詞是 the boys（複數），動詞用 are
He is the only one of the applicants who ____ able to speak three languages.
the only one 是先行詞，單數，用 is
The gentleman ____ spoke to you just now is our principal.
先行詞是人且子句缺主詞，用主格 who
I have lost the pen ____ my father bought for me.
先行詞是物且 bought 缺受詞，用 which
The scientist ____ invention changed the world died yesterday.
The man ____ I think is honest will be hired.
刪掉插入語 I think 後，is 仍缺主詞，用主格 who
My father, ____ works abroad, comes home only once a year.
逗號後（非限定用法）禁用 that
He tried to solve the problem, ____ turned out to be impossible.
逗號 + which 代指前面整件事
Yushan, ____ is the highest mountain in Northeast Asia, attracts many hikers.
專有名詞後用非限定用法，禁用 that
There are fifty students in the class, most of ____ are boys.
介系詞 of + 受格關代 whom（先行詞是人）
Betty has applied for many job openings, one of ____ is working as an assistant.
one of which；先行詞是事物
There is a terrible car accident on Expressway 4, ____ means we will be late.
Helen didn't pass the exam, ____ disappointed her parents a lot.
逗號 + which 代指整件事
This is the tool ____ I fixed the computer.
介系詞前移時只能用 which，不可用 that
The police have tried to find the person ____ the car belongs.
belong to；介系詞前移接 whom
Ms. Lin is the teacher ____ I owe my success.
owe sth. to sb.；介系詞前移只能用 whom
This is the village in that the famous writer was born.
This is the village in which the famous writer was born.
This is the village which the writer was born.
This is the village in where the writer was born.
This is the house ____ I live.
Please give me all the money ____ you have.
先行詞被 all 修飾時，關代要用 that
Milton is the most gentle and generous man ____ I have ever known.
先行詞被最高級修飾，用 that
The boy and his bike ____ were hit by the truck are gone.
先行詞同時包含人與物，用 that
This is the only book ____ worth reading.
先行詞被 the only 修飾，用 that
He is the smartest student ____ I have ever met.
最高級修飾先行詞，用 that
My father, that works abroad, comes home once a year.
My father, who works abroad, comes home once a year.
My father, which works abroad, comes home once a year.
My father that works abroad, comes home once a year.
This is the park ____ we used to play soccer.
play soccer 不缺受詞，先行詞是地點，用關係副詞 where
This is the hotel ____ we stayed last summer.
stay 不及物，子句不缺成分，用 where
Please tell me the way ____ you made this delicious cake.
the way 與 how 只能二選一；the way in which 可以
There are times ____ you just want to sit back and relax.
先行詞是時間且子句完整，用 when
We have come to a stage ____ compromise is the only choice.
抽象先行詞 stage 也可用 where
There are situations ____ telling a white lie may be acceptable.
situation 是抽象先行詞，用 where
I still clearly remember the days ____ we spent together.
spent 缺受詞，受格關代可省略
This is the way how I solved the problem.
This is how I solved the problem.
This is the way how I did solve it.
This is the how way I solved it.
the way 與 how 不可並用
I still remember the day ____ we first met in college.
先行詞是時間且子句完整，用 when
Do you know the reason ____ he refused the offer?
____ he says is not important to me at all.
What ＝ the thing that，本身含先行詞
____ I have just told you is a secret. Don't tell anyone about it.
What 當主詞；All what 是錯的
____ you need to do is keep it confidential and tell no one.
All (that) you need to do is…
____ is often the case, he was late for the meeting again.
As is often the case 這是常有的事
____ I have told you, this is a secret and should not be revealed.
As 引導的非限定子句可放句首，which 不行
You may take ____ seat you like; they are all available.
what 當補語，表「所需要的東西」
Please tell me all what you know.
Please tell me all that you know.
Please tell me what all you know.
Please tell me all which you know.
all 後面用 that，不用 what
The ideas ____ in his speech are truly inspiring.
被動簡化用 p.p.（which were presented → presented）
The village ____ at the foot of the mountain was destroyed by the floods.
be located at… 簡化後留 located
Most of the people ____ in line are teenagers hoping to see the superstar.
Wendy is the woman ____ for organizing the whole trip.
who is responsible → responsible（形容詞片語）
The novel, ____ in 1925, is still popular today.
The little girl ____ by the police was sent back to her parents.
小女孩是被找到，用 p.p. found
In recent years, the movies ____ in Taiwan have gained recognition, and the places ____ these movies are shot have become popular.
第一格被動簡化 produced；第二格先行詞是地點且子句完整，用 where
The Louvre Pyramid ____ was designed by I. M. Pei, is a glass-and-steel structure.
非限定用法只能用 which
The old house, ____ walls were covered with ivy, has stood here for a century.
I visited the National Palace Museum, ____ is famous for its jade collection.
兩個句子不可只用逗號連接，要用關代 which
The movie which we saw it last night was boring.
The movie which we saw last night was boring.
The movie which we saw it was boring last night.
The movie what we saw last night was boring.
關代已代替受詞，不可再留 it
The company in that she works is well-known.
The company in which she works is well-known.
The company in where she works is well-known.
The company in what she works is well-known.
He is one of the few students who has finished the project.
He is one of the few students who have finished the project.
He is one of the few students which have finished it.
He is one of the few student who have finished it.
先行詞 the few students 是複數，用 have
This is the boy ____ I told you about yesterday.
受格關代，先行詞是人用 whom
He has two daughters, ____ of ____ are married.
Whatever is worth ____ is worth ____ well.
Anyone who wants to come is welcome. ＝ ____ wants to come is welcome.
Bubble tea, ____ was invented in Taiwan in the 1980s, has become popular worldwide.
Bubble tea has become a drink ____ people all over the world enjoy.
enjoy 缺受詞，先行詞是物，用 that/which
The chewy balls ____ are added to the tea are made from tapioca.
Tapioca is a starch ____ comes from the cassava root.
Many shops ____ in night markets offer dozens of flavors.
which are located 簡化為 located
The shop offers dozens of flavors, ____ makes choosing difficult for first-time customers.
逗號 + which 代指前面整件事
Taichung is often said to be the city ____ the drink was first created.
先行詞是地點且子句完整，用 where
The shop owners ____ claim to be the inventor are more than one.
____ is certain is that bubble tea has traveled far beyond the island.
Bubble tea has traveled far beyond the island ____ it was born.
先行詞是地點且子句完整，用 where
Teenagers place greater value on the opinions of their peers than on ____ of their parents.
代替複數名詞 opinions 用 those
It is hard to explain why the salary of men is higher than ____ of women.
代替單數名詞 salary 用 that
The plan proposed by Ellen is much more innovative than ____ proposed by the manager.
代替單數名詞 plan 用 that
While their product is made of single-use plastic, ____ designed by our company is eco-friendly.
代替單數名詞 product 用 that
The living standard in a developed country seems higher than ____ in a developing country.
The influence of smartphones on children ____ by more and more parents over the years.
over the years 用現在完成式被動
So far, the Holy Bible ____ into 698 languages, and the job is still ongoing.
So far 用現在完成式；聖經是被翻譯
One is Italy, another is Canada, and ____ is Hawaii.
三者以上：one… another… still another…
Eagerly waiting for the next show, all the children wondered ____ was inside the box.
University education is not the only route ____ a successful career.
the route to… 通往…的途徑
____ her twin sister, Lucy would like to major in law rather than study medicine.
____ that Ken worked hard for his company, he still got fired.
Although + 子句；Despite 後接名詞
____ the fact that Jack is not a Christian, he always begins meals with a prayer.
Despite the fact that… 儘管…
Many children enjoyed their cake right away, ____ little Maggie took hers home to share.
The passengers who were waiting for the delayed flight looked exhausted. 簡化後是？
The passengers waiting for the delayed flight looked exhausted.
The passengers waited for the delayed flight looked exhausted.
The passengers which waiting for the flight looked exhausted.
The passengers to wait for the flight looked exhausted.
who were + V-ing → 直接留 V-ing
The letter which was written in French was hard to read. 簡化後是？
The letter writing in French was hard to read.
The letter written in French was hard to read.
The letter which writing in French was hard to read.
The letter to write in French was hard to read.
the boy who is crying 簡化後最自然的說法是？
簡化後只剩一個字，通常移到名詞前
This is the same watch ____ I lost.
the same… as 表「同款」；the same… that 才是「就是那支」
c: 【課文】An innovative team-building exercise ____ as the Marshmallow Challenge promises to do just that.
known as… 被稱為…（形容詞子句簡化）
【課文】Teams need to build the tallest free-standing structure ____ of supporting the weight of one marshmallow.
【課文】With only 18 minutes to complete the task, the teams must learn to ____ quickly.
【課文】The group ____ built the highest structure was, as expected, architects and engineers.
主格關代，先行詞是 the group
【課文】CEOs performed ____ better than average, coming in third.
修飾比較級用副詞 slightly
【課文】Lawyers performed below average, ____ second to last.
【課文】Kindergarteners outperformed most adult teams, ____ the second-best performance.
【課文】The kindergarten group, ____ structures were taller than those of most adult teams, impressed everyone.
